statement: MIGRATION NEEDED: tenant-scoped durable verified webhook receipts with replayable payloads, per-step outcomes/checkpoints, attempts, retry timestamps and bounded claiming. No migration number is assigned. The independent unconfigured-metrics no-op and linked-flow preservation are now implemented; durable ingestion and internal retries remain unimplemented.
stop_authority: aeon-1241-webhook502.md, Build 3: if you need a migration, write MIGRATION NEEDED in your evidence and stop before writing one.
changes: Unconfigured metrics return explicit not_configured/nothing_to_record outcomes without writing metric runs, pulls or review marks.

Completed Actions suites skip the Actions read only when neither a metric source nor a linked delivery flow consumer needs it. Linked PR heads, explicit suite PRs, stored queue heads and queue branch PRs retain the checks/queue flow path and default CI workflow.
Failed check-audit, merge-audit, metric and flow work retains its content-free step/error class; flow-only Actions failures remain 502.
Expanded the existing ESSENTIAL regression with linked/unlinked suites, queue subjects, upstream failure, explicit redelivery and idempotent flow effects; no test is skipped or weakened.
Merged the newer origin/main cleanly; no migration, API, permission, version or UI changes were authored.

reproduction.risk: Unconfigured metrics must not reject authenticated deliveries on unnecessary Actions reads or suppress linked checks/queue flow facts.
reproduction.fixture: Signed HTTP mux, installation/repository binding, RLS-backed transactions and injected GitHub reads. No metric source is created; linked scenarios explicitly create a ticket-linked delivery item.
reproduction.desired: 204 with no metric rows; Actions reads and flow rows only for linked consumers. A required read failure is a visible 502/flow/github_unavailable, not silent success.
reproduction.baseline_result: CONFIRMED expected regression failure, exit 1, on test-only commit 0e91ccee4 (application files unchanged from 5da91b7f): read_available wrote one unwanted metric fact; read_unavailable returned 502 instead of 204; linked_read_failure_then_redelivery logged audit instead of flow. The initial queue fixture also failed for its invalid subject and was subsequently corrected independently; it is not used as defect evidence.
reproduction.fixed_result: Full internal/delivery passed remotely on 21e09932d in 47.432 seconds after the queue fixture corrections, including the linked/unlinked suite, queue and explicit-redelivery assertions. The subsequent refs/heads-prefixed suite guard and clean origin/main merges were formatted but not compiled or executed in a final Go run: repeated final reruns were refused with exit 3 (load 15 > 12 or 2/2 remote slots).
reproduction.explicit_redelivery_limit: The test manually resends the same signed delivery and asserts convergent flow effects. It does not prove internal retry; durable receipt/retry remains blocked on the coordinator migration assignment.

storage_findings.finding: delivery_github_events has payload_sha256 and typed normalized observations, but no raw delivery, per-step checkpoints, attempt count, retry schedule or lease. processed_at is populated at the projection write, before the audit/metrics/flow/completion chain finishes.
GitHub/network observation reads occur before recordTx. A failure there leaves no durable delivery receipt. workflow_run is accepted without a projection ledger entry.

The projection record insert deduplicates on tenant_id/delivery_id. Inserting the current ledger row before reads would cause the duplicate path and ON CONFLICT to skip the unfinished projection. Rebuild decodes observations as []Observation.
audit_checks is consumed as check facts; observations are consumed with jsonb_array_elements. Repurposing either typed field to hold payload/retry state would change existing reader semantics.

inbox_messages requires sender/recipient principals and a message body of at most 65536 characters. inbox_wakes is an outbound wake-hint queue tied to an enabled principal webhook target, not an inbound service receipt. It cannot faithfully retain all allowed 2 MiB webhook bodies without repurposing user messaging.
Existing internal replay scans unfinished fanout_done only. It cannot replay audit, metrics, flow, completion or deliveries that failed before a ledger row was inserted.

jobScope returns an empty workflow list for an unlinked repository, but metricsEvent still calls MetricsRead/suiteRuns for a completed GitHub Actions suite. Source absence itself is not an error; the unnecessary API read can fail.
Check audit, merge audit, metrics and flow share the audit error label. Later steps stop on any earlier error and depend on a fresh delivery for replay.
Merge completion is an additional downstream step after auditWebhook; a durable chain must include it to avoid regressions.

The existing ledger classifies audit_checks as metadata and observations as review. A raw payload needs a deliberate inventory classification and tenant-scoped locator in the same authorized expansion.

continuation_requirements: Coordinator assigns an expansion migration number above the released maximum; prefer a dedicated durable receipt table using the existing tenant-scoped ledger pattern, with DSAR inventory in the same change.

Commit a bounded, verified delivery receipt before network/step work; retain event, action, repository, installation binding, delivery id, payload hash and replayable verified payload without persisting signatures or credentials. Reject reuse of a delivery id with different authenticated content.
Use explicit recorded/not-configured/nothing-to-record/failed outcomes. Distinguish projection/fanout/check-audit/merge-audit/metrics/flow/completion in content-free failure logs.

Replay failed steps internally across restart/replicas with bounded claiming, timeouts, injected-clock backoff and idempotent effects. Do not discard pending facts on retry exhaustion or rely on GitHub redelivery.
Preserve tenant -> tree -> record -> sorted blob -> event-counter lock order and current-target authorization in final mutation transactions; no network I/O under those row locks.
Do not skip delivery flow facts merely because metrics are unconfigured. Delivery Flow here is independent of the retired Journey/stage system.

Keep the new regression assertions and add failure -> internal retry -> exactly-once effect tests for each step, plus restart/duplicate/concurrency/integrity checks. Do not report completion or release acceptance before they pass.
